categories.main_business_segments: Eoptolink Technology Inc., Ltd primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of optical communication modules. Its product portfolio includes high-performance optical modules such as 100G, 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T modules used in AI/machine learning clusters, cloud data centers, data communication, 5G wireless networks, telecom transmission, and fixed network access. The company also offers coherent optical modules and silicon photonics solutions, serving both domestic and international customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including VCSEL/EML, silicon photonics, thin-film lithium niobate, coherent optical communication, and LPO (Linear Polarization Optical) technology. It has capabilities in high-speed optical device chip packaging and optical device packaging. Production is order-based, managed via an ERP system to optimize material usage and control costs. The company emphasizes automation, lean manufacturing, and continuous process improvements to enhance efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global mainstream internet companies and communication equipment manufacturers. The products serve data centers, AI/machine learning clusters, cloud computing networks, 5G front-haul, mid-haul, backhaul networks, metropolitan area networks, backbone networks, and core networks. The company’s sales are predominantly to communication equipment manufacturers and internet firms both domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: Eoptolink operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chengdu, Sichuan Free Trade Zone. It has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, the United States, Singapore, Thailand, and other international locations. The company’s sales are mainly international, with approximately 78.7% of revenue from overseas markets and 21.3% from domestic sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the optical communication supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of optical modules. It procures upstream components such as optical chips, TO-CAN packages, and integrated circuits from suppliers, and sells finished optical modules downstream to communication equipment manufacturers and internet companies. It is pursuing vertical integration to cover optical chip manufacturing, chip packaging, device packaging, and module manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-speed optical modules (up to 1.6T), silicon photonics, coherent optical modules, and LPO technology. The company invests heavily in R&D, with a 4.66% revenue allocation in 2024, focusing on low-power, long-distance, and data center interconnect modules. It aims to enhance AI and cloud data center applications, expand production capacity, and strengthen global market competitiveness. Talent development, automation, and digitalization of manufacturing are also key R&D and operational focuses.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical communication modules to communication equipment manufacturers and internet companies. The company uses a direct sales model domestically and a combination of direct and buyout distributor sales internationally. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and acceptance of goods, with various terms depending on domestic or international sales contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Eoptolink is positioned as a leading domestic optical module supplier with capabilities in high-speed optical modules and chip packaging technology. It is among the few Chinese companies capable of mass-producing 100G to 800G modules and is expanding into 1.6T modules. The company competes globally with major optical module manufacturers and aims to consolidate its core competitiveness through vertical integration and technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 8.65 billion, a 179.15% increase from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.84 billion, a 312.26% increase. Total assets reached RMB 12.27 billion, nearly doubling from the previous year. The company has shown rapid growth driven by increased market demand and expanded production capacity, with a strong profitability profile and a return on equity of 41%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Eoptolink emphasizes high-performance, high-speed optical modules with advanced packaging technologies, low power consumption, and broad application coverage from data centers to 5G networks. Its product differentiation lies in its comprehensive product range, technological innovation in silicon photonics and coherent optics, and flexible manufacturing capabilities. The company’s vertical integration strategy enhances supply chain stability and cost control, providing customers with reliable, cutting-edge optical communication solutions.
